name: College admissions consultant

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Strategy session
services.story: The main story: a $55 strategy session by video, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Essay review
services.story: A $35 essay review: a card is saved for the $20 late-cancel fee, and the $35 is charged when the advisor texts DONE.

services.name: Application package
services.story: A $640 application package, quoted from the family's answers: a $160 deposit now, and the $480 rest at the front desk.

services.name: Quick check
services.story: A $25 quick check at the office: nothing is taken, and the family pays at the front desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Campus visit at home
services.story: The main story: a $179 campus visit at home; a card is saved for the $89 visit fee and the $179 is charged when the advisor texts DONE.

services.name: Application package at home
services.story: A $640 application package at the family's home, quoted from the family's answers: a $160 deposit now, and the $480 rest on the bill after.

services.name: Family info night
services.story: A $179 family info night at a host's place: nothing is taken, and the bill is texted after.

services.name: Campus visit at home, paid in full
services.story: A $150 campus visit at home, paid in full when booking; a late cancel may keep the $89 visit fee.

services_shape: College advising: strategy sessions, essay reviews and an application plan, by video, by phone or at the office (flow A), and a campus visit at a family's home or a family information night at a host's place (flow B). Every new family starts with a free intro call with the student and a parent. Advice is not a promise of admission.
questions_before_times: Who is the session for: the student, a parent, or both? What's the goal: a plan, essays, or a visit?
Roughly when, and how many people?
At the office, by video or phone, or at your home?
safety_stop: someone in danger or hurt right now, at school, at home or anywhere
crisis words, from the student or a parent
a student who says an adult is hurting them
license: No license is needed for this work in most places. A registration or certificate the state asks for is the business's own to add. It is optional, and nothing is looked up.
messages_never: A student's grades, test scores, school records, learning needs, family money or aid, health, and anything the family shares about the student's life.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
